The continuous first variation of the power norm yields a two-site semicircular minimax; matching upper and lower bounds give kappa = 1/2 min_x(h_plus+h_minus). Grid midpoint displacement yields even versus odd entropy formulas; an exceptional site on the antipodal arc boundary is handled explicitly. All quantified n>=4 and finite p>1 statements have analytic proofs; 42 finite difference comparisons supplement rather than certify the continuum.
